column4: \tそしてすっかり安心しきたった時に事件は起こった。
column5: And just when everyone had completely let their guard down, the incident occurred.

column4: \tパーティの日、バードが現れた。
column5: On the day of the party, Bird appeared.

column4: \t人類を魔物を全てを制したランスに敵はいない
column5: There was no enemy to Rance, who had conquered all humans and monsters.

column4: \tランスも安心しきっていた
column5: Rance was also completely at ease.

column4: \tＡ．バードはランスを襲おうとして、庇ったシィルを殺す
column5: A. Bird tried to attack Rance but killed Sill who protected him.

column4: \tシィルはまっぷたつになり死んでしまう
column5: Sill was split in two and died.

column4: \t注意：このパーティの時、クルックーは、女神アリスと会っています
column5: Note: During this party, Crook met the goddess ALICE.

column4: \tシィルを抱きしめるランス、その手の中でどんどん体温を失い死にかけるシィル
column5: Rance embraces Sill, who is rapidly losing body heat and dying in his arms.

column4: \tこら死ぬなーといっても流石に無理なのはランスから見ても明らか
column5: Even though Rance says, 'Don't die,' it's clear to him that it's hopeless.

column4: \tなんかそれなり感動的な事をいいながら死んでいく
column5: Shiru says something somewhat touching as she dies.
